games.title: Dock Ledger
games.author: House
games.blurb: Night shift on the harbor. Berth the boats before they drift.
games.description: A desk simulator. Incoming hulls have size, cargo, and patience. Assign a free berth, unload, and keep the ledger green until the horn. No 3D build — one HTML file.
games.controls: Click a berth to assign the next hull.

games.title: Ash Fold
games.author: House
games.blurb: Slide the tiles. Reconstruct the letter that burned.
games.description: A 4×4 sliding puzzle. Click a tile beside the gap. Clear the grid in as few moves as you can.
games.controls: Click a tile next to the gap.

games.title: Void Line
games.author: House
games.blurb: Hold the rail. Punch holes in the inbound fleet.
games.description: Vertical shooter. Move with arrows or WASD, space to fire. Survive waves and do not let a hull cross the line.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD to move. Space fires.

games.title: Night Clerk
games.author: House
games.blurb: Keep the flashlight on the things that only move in the dark.
games.description: You are a circle of light in a shut museum. WASD to move. The pale shapes freeze when lit and sprint when you look away. Last until dawn.

games.title: Metro Seed
games.author: House
games.blurb: Plant stations. Collect fares. Grow a tiny transit company.
games.description: Click the lantern to collect fares, then buy lines and crews. An idle sim that lives in one page — no backend, no save server.
games.controls: Click the lantern, then buy lines.

games.title: Wire Beat
games.author: House
games.blurb: Four wires. Hit D F J K when the pulse kisses the rail.
games.description: A rhythm cabinet. Notes fall on four lanes. Catch them on the line. Miss too many and the grid browns out.
games.controls: D F J K when a note reaches the rail.

games.title: Hex Claim
games.author: House
games.blurb: Take the next hex. The other color is also thinking.
games.description: Turn-based hex grab. Click a cell next to yours. The rival claims after you. First to the target, or most cells when the board fills, wins.
games.controls: Click a hex next to yours.

games.title: Lane Heat
games.author: House
games.blurb: Three lanes. Do not kiss the freight.
games.description: Arcade racer. Left/right to change lane. Last as the traffic thickens. Distance is the score.
games.controls: Left and right to change lane.

games.title: Kiln Rally
games.author: House
games.blurb: Catch falling bricks to widen your cart, then bank the spark into the kiln.
games.description: A C++ game compiled with Emscripten to WebAssembly and SDL2. Bricks drop onto a clay court and stack into bounce geometry. Catch one before it lands and your cart grows wider for a while. The spark is a puck: slide under it, angle it off the stacks, and lodge it in the kiln mouth on the right. Three drops and the rally ends. Original code and shapes only — a brick workshop crossed with a puck sport, under its own name.
games.mashup: A brick-stacking workshop crossed with a bouncing puck sport.
games.controls: Arrows or A/D slide the cart. Space catches a brick. Drag the court to move. R restarts after five misses.

games.title: Plot Puck
games.author: House
games.blurb: Plant springy garden plots, then ricochet a seed into the glasshouse.
games.description: An HTML canvas game. Soil squares are soft and kill the bounce. Plant a plot and it becomes a leafy bumper. You get a handful of plots and three seed launches. The glasshouse on the right only counts a seed that still has speed. Original shapes, no outside art — a garden planner crossed with a table puck.
games.mashup: A garden planner crossed with a table puck.
games.controls: Click soil to plant. Space or Launch seed drops the seed. Three launches, then replant.

games.title: Lantern Reach
games.author: House
games.blurb: Tap the buoys in time and steer a paper lantern down the night river.
games.description: An HTML canvas game. Four lanes of diamond buoys drift toward a line. Hit the matching key as a buoy arrives and the lantern slides into that lane, keeping its glow. Miss, and the glow thins until the river goes dark. Distance is the score. Original geometry only — a four-lane rhythm game crossed with a lantern-boat race.
games.mashup: A four-lane rhythm game crossed with a lantern-boat race.
games.controls: D F J K, or the arrow keys, or tap a lane. Tap again after the glow goes out.
